excerpt: The Mu2e experiment at Fermilab is designed to search for charged lepton flavor violation (CLFV) by looking for the rare, neutrinoless conversion of a muon into an electron in the Coulomb field of a nucleus.
title: Status of the Mu2e experiment at Fermilab (A. Driutti for the Mu2e Collaboration, PoS WIFAI2025 020)
